headline: Remember the 4 rotator cuff muscles with SITS
stat_note: the 4 muscles of the rotator cuff
body:
S = Supraspinatus
I = Infraspinatus
T = Teres minor
S = Subscapularis
source: Source: Healthline, Rotator Cuff Anatomy (medically reviewed)

headline: The biggest muscle in your body is in your backside
body: Your gluteus maximus is not only the biggest muscle you have, it is also the strongest.

headline: Your cornea has no blood vessels at all
stat_note: blood vessels in a healthy cornea
body: To stay clear, it takes oxygen from tears and directly from the air, and nutrients from tears and the aqueous humor.
source: Source: University of Michigan Health; Healthline, Cornea
